title: ZX Bank Ltd. – Current Account Overview

nodes.title: Current Account Features
nodes.summary: Features include zero initial deposit (as per eligibility), high monthly cash limits, multi-location access to 560+ branches and 1,200+ ATMs, a digital banking suite (IMPS/NEFT/RTGS/UPI, bill payments), personalised cheque book and debit card, overdraft facility, a dedicated relationship manager, and exclusive offers.

nodes.title: Minimum Balance Requirement
nodes.summary: Only a monthly average balance of ₹10,000 is required, with a non-maintenance fee of ₹500 per month if not maintained.

nodes.title: How to Apply for a Current Account
nodes.summary: Online: open at zxbank.asia with digital e-KYC (Aadhaar/PAN), upload business documents, pick a branch and verify by OTP. Offline: visit a branch, fill the form, submit KYC, complete biometric verification, and the account activates within 24 hours.

nodes.title: ZX Current Account Welcome Kit
nodes.summary: Opening a current account delivers an exclusive welcome kit of travel gear, a personalised debit card, a starter cheque book, instant digital access, and health and insurance coverage.

children.title: What’s in the Kit?
children.summary: The kit includes a premium travel bag, universal travel adapter (4 plugs for 150 countries), personalised debit card, starter cheque book, NetBanking and app access, and exclusive health insurance of ₹10,00,000 with cashless hospitalization.

nodes.title: Why Choose ZX Bank for Your Current Account?
nodes.summary: Reasons include paperless digital onboarding, a rewarding welcome kit, easy access to funds and credit, comprehensive insurance, pan-South-Asia remittance support, priority servicing, and full digital control via the ZX Bank Asia app.
